name: Olga Gedola
bio_fr:
Olga Gedola is a Ukrainian self-taught artist currently living and working in Ankara, Türkiye. Specializing in Pop Art sculptures and figurative creations, she develops a distinctive artistic language through bold forms, expressive characters and vibrant visual elements.

Her sculptural practice combines contemporary Pop Art aesthetics with playful interpretations of nature and iconic figures, creating distinctive objects that celebrate individuality, strength and artistic expression.
